Grab your FREE Central TX Relocation Guide and start planning your move with confidence:  🔗 https://bit.ly/3DWFw7V
----------
Thinking about Central Texas relocation and trying to figure out which Central Texas suburbs actually fit your lifestyle? In this video, Matt Dick and I take you on a real-time tour of three underrated small towns in Central Texas: Nolanville, Troy, and Little River Academy.

If you’ve been considering living in Central Texas, moving to Central Texas, or exploring the best towns in Central Texas, this tour gives you an honest look at neighborhoods, schools, roads, and what everyday life really feels like! We also break down the affordability of these areas, including what $400K can buy in each market. Whether you're relocating for work, hospitals, Fort Hood, or you just want that quieter, small-town lifestyle, these communities offer options that feel close to everything while still giving you space.

Here’s what we cover:
✔️ Troy, TX – Small-town charm, quick access to Temple and Waco, lower property taxes, and strong schools with smaller class sizes. View Homes For Sale in Troy TX: https://www.livinginctx.com/cities/troy
✔️ Little River Academy – A tight-knit community with great schools and families who love coming back for its warm, welcoming vibe. View Homes For Sale in Little River Academy TX: https://www.livinginctx.com/cities/little-river-academy
✔️ Nolanville, TX – A great middle ground for those working near Fort Hood or wanting more privacy without giving up convenience. View Homes For Sale in Nolanville TX: https://www.livinginctx.com/cities/nolanville

You’ll also see the range of Central Texas real estate, including new construction and resale homes across multiple price points. And yes — we’ve got another video coming soon featuring even more new builds in the Temple TX suburbs and Waco TX suburbs!
